# dsh-miliastra v0.6.2

**安装**：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.2` → 重启 `dsh web`
**Install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.2`, then restart `dsh web`.

[中文](#cn-v0.6.2) | [English](#en-v0.6.2)

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.2">✨ 新增功能</h3>

- **网格图单独滚轮缩放**：鼠标停在网格图上滚滚轮就缩放（**面板本身不跟着滚**），放大后用图自己的滚动条平移；
  旁边那颗按钮是读数 + 复位（`缩放 100%`）。范围 **25% ~ 800%**，值进缓存。 @LoktLin
- **放大后左键按住拖动（平移）**：拖的是图那个滚动盒子。与「点一格 = 选中/取消」共存的办法是**位移超过 3px 才算拖**，
  拖过之后把随后那次 `click` 吃掉 —— 否则松手会顺手多选/取消一格。 @LoktLin
- **右键标记颜色 → 导出直接带 `color`**：色板 **8 色**（第一个是作者例子里的灰 `#d6d7dc`）；
  点一个当笔刷 → 图上**右键点格**上色，**同一个色再右键一次 = 清除**；另有「清除标记」。
  标记的格在图上画成半透明色块，右键时顺手把那一格选上。导出的片段逐字照作者给的例子：
  ```
  [{x = 330, y = 560 ,color="#d6d7dc",colorName = "灰色"}]
  ```
  没标色的格照旧 `{x = 330, y = 560 }`（两种混着来也各自正确）。 @LoktLin
- **选中列表加「四角」下拉**：`右下（默认）/ 左下 / 左上 / 右上` —— 决定复制出去的 `x,y` 取这一格的哪个角，
  列表每行标明用的是哪个角。 @LoktLin
- **格内灰字坐标与「取哪一角」联动**：`坐标 x,y` 这一档显示的**就是**下拉选的那个角（默认右下），
  按钮名字里把当前角写出来（`坐标 x,y（右下）`），换角时格内灰字立刻跟着变。 @LoktLin
- **面板「常驻」开关 + 可以拖拉**：头部 `📌 常驻` **默认开** ⇒ 点面板外面（含点输入框）不会关；
  **按住头部**可以把面板挪到任意位置，**双击头部回原位**，位置也记住。开合状态与常驻开关同样记住。 @LoktLin

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.2-improve">🎨 体验优化</h3>

- **网格计算的值会被缓存**（`localStorage` 键 `dsh-miliastra:grid`）：画布宽高 / X Y 步长 / 两个换算输入 / 格内标档 /
  多选列表 / 四角 / 缩放 / 颜色标记 / 笔刷 —— 下次打开面板（含刷新页面）原样还在。
- **网格页瘦身**：按作者要求**隐掉**逐格速查表、`像素 → 格`、`格 → 像素`（代码与纯函数全部保留，只是不渲染）；
  删掉「画布与步长」底部那段说明与网格图下面的图例；「当前点」那行只在**点落空**（残格 / 画布外）时出现。
  结论字体**放大**（10.5px → **14px**）。
- **面板尺寸回到 880×600**（作者：「还是改回原来的大小其他不变」），拖拽下限回 `420×340`。
- `tools/dump-panel-text.mjs` 支持 **`--tab <页>`**（改面板文案时先以使用者视角读一遍那一页）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.2-bug">🐛 问题修复</h3>

- **平移后"第一下点击没反应"**：拖到格子外面松手时 `click` 打不到 SVG，那个"吃掉一次点击"的标记会留到下一次 ⇒
  现在 **mousedown 先清零**。 @LoktLin
- **格内坐标标签会越到邻格里去**：联动到角以后文本变长（中心 `'50,25'` → 右下 `'1600,1000'` 是 9 个字符），
  而字号是按一个固定的"每字符系数"算的 ⇒ 改成按**真实最长文本长度**算（`stepX×0.9 / (最长文本×0.58)`）。 @LoktLin
- **`package-lock.json` 根版本漂移**（自 0.5.1 起没跟 `package.json` 同步）⇒ 已修正到 0.6.2。 @LoktLin

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.2-chores">⚠️ 其他变更</h3>

- **只改了 `lib/client.js` 一侧** ⇒ 装完/拉源码后**刷新页面（F5）**即可；Host 半边一个字没动、**不用重启 `dsh web`**。
- **界面未做视觉验证**（开发机没有浏览器）：滚轮缩放、鼠标平移、右键标记、四角联动、字号算式、缓存降级都由
  **真 React 静态渲染 + 源码断言**钉住（`client-render-test` **49 → 68** 条断言），但手感与可读性仍需人眼过一遍。
  ⚠️ 已知取舍：`100×50` 有 16 列，默认面板下每格约 34px 宽，9 个字符（`1600,1000`）塞不下 ⇒ 字号会偏小，
  **请滚轮放大看**，或切「格号 col,row」档（5 个字符，字号翻倍），或把面板拖大。
- **坐标口径**：本页 = **设计画布**（左上 (0,0)、x 右增、**y 下增**）；模拟器内部舞台那套「左下原点」是另一层，有反向绊线钉住不许混用。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.6.1...v0.6.2

---

<h3 id="en-v0.6.2">✨ New Features</h3>

- **Wheel zoom scoped to the grid image**: put the pointer over the grid and scroll — only the grid zooms (the panel itself does not
  scroll). Pan afterwards with the grid's own scrollbars; the button next to it shows the current ratio and resets it (`缩放 100%`).
  Range **25% – 800%**, persisted. @LoktLin
- **Left-button drag to pan once zoomed in**: it moves the grid's scroll box. So that "click a cell to select/deselect" still works,
  **a drag only counts past 3px**, and the trailing `click` is swallowed — otherwise releasing would toggle a cell by accident. @LoktLin
- **Right-click to mark a colour, exported as `color`**: an **8-colour** palette (the first is the author's `#d6d7dc` grey);
  pick one as the brush, then **right-click a cell** to paint it — **the same colour again clears it**, plus a "clear marks" button.
  Marked cells are drawn as translucent blocks, and right-clicking also selects that cell. The exported fragment is byte-for-byte
  the author's example:
  ```
  [{x = 330, y = 560 ,color="#d6d7dc",colorName = "灰色"}]
  ```
  Unmarked cells stay `{x = 330, y = 560 }` (mixing both forms is fine). @LoktLin
- **A "which corner" dropdown in the selection list**: `bottom-right (default) / bottom-left / top-left / top-right` decides which corner
  of the cell the exported `x,y` refers to; every list row names the corner it used. @LoktLin
- **The in-cell grey coordinates follow that dropdown**: the `坐标 x,y` mode shows exactly the chosen corner (bottom-right by default),
  the button label states the current corner (`坐标 x,y（右下）`), and switching it updates the labels immediately. @LoktLin
- **A "pinned" switch on the panel, plus dragging**: the header's `📌 常驻` is **on by default** ⇒ clicking outside (including into an
  input) no longer closes the panel; **hold the header to move the panel anywhere**, **double-click it to snap back**, and the position
  is remembered — as are the open/closed and pinned states. @LoktLin

<h3 id="en-v0.6.2-improve">🎨 Improvements</h3>

- **Grid values are cached** (`localStorage` key `dsh-miliastra:grid`): canvas size, X/Y steps, both conversion inputs, label mode,
  the multi-select list, the corner, the zoom, the colour marks and the brush — all restored on the next visit (refresh included).
- **The grid page was slimmed down** at the author's request: the per-cell lookup table, `pixel → cell` and `cell → pixel` are **hidden**
  (code and pure functions are kept, they are simply not rendered); the paragraph at the bottom of the canvas card and the legend under
  the grid are gone; the "current point" line only appears when a click **lands outside a cell** (leftover strip / off-canvas).
  The verdict text is **larger** (10.5px → **14px**).
- **The panel is back to 880×600** (the author: "change it back to the original size, everything else unchanged"), with the resize floor
  back at `420×340`.
- `tools/dump-panel-text.mjs` accepts **`--tab <page>`** (read one page as a user would before touching its copy).

<h3 id="en-v0.6.2-bug">🐛 Bug Fixes</h3>

- **"The first click does nothing" after panning**: when a drag ended outside the grid, `click` never reached the SVG and the
  swallow-once flag survived into the next interaction ⇒ it is now **cleared on every mousedown**. @LoktLin
- **In-cell coordinate labels could spill into the neighbouring cell**: linked to the corner, the text got longer (centre `'50,25'`
  vs bottom-right `'1600,1000'`, 9 characters), while the font size was derived from a fixed per-character factor ⇒ it is now derived
  from the **actual longest text** (`stepX×0.9 / (longest text × 0.58)`). @LoktLin
- **`package-lock.json`'s root version had drifted** (unsynced since 0.5.1) ⇒ corrected to 0.6.2. @LoktLin

<h3 id="en-v0.6.2-chores">⚠️ Chores</h3>

- **Only `lib/client.js` changed** ⇒ after installing or pulling, a **page refresh (F5)** is enough; the Host half is untouched and
  **`dsh web` need not restart**.
- **No visual verification** (no browser on the dev machine): wheel zoom, drag-pan, right-click marking, the corner linkage, the font-size
  formula and the cache fallbacks are pinned by **real React static render + source assertions** (`client-render-test` **49 → 68**
  assertions), but the feel and legibility still need a human eye.
  ⚠️ Known trade-off: a 100×50 grid has 16 columns, so at the default panel width each cell is ~34px wide and 9 characters (`1600,1000`)
  cannot fit ⇒ the font is small. **Zoom in with the wheel**, switch to the `格号 col,row` mode (5 characters, double the font size), or
  drag the panel larger.
- **Coordinate frame**: this page uses the **design canvas** (origin top-left, x right, **y down**); the simulator's internal stage
  ("origin bottom-left") is a different layer, and an inverted tripwire keeps the two from being mixed up.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.6.1...v0.6.2
